title: Prove exact main artifacts and consumer proof reach release promotion
text: The corrected commit-tag API is served. Candidate code promotes verified exact-main wheel bytes and native image digests, retires tag allocation and reuses exact product/consumer proof. Platform consumer integration of tag-bound exact-pair proof is delivered: the consumer proves the dispatched commit and its release route reuses only a matching successful dispatched run. Production artifact equality and release-duration savings remain unclaimed until a real release joins an early proof and records its dispatch count and residual wait; no live speed improvement is claimed. Rollout also owes proof that existing relay bootstraps can install numeric release identities before activation.
